Where do I recharge?+

TikTok Coins links open TikTok. Game links open that exact product in the LootBar Ten store. Choose your pack and complete payment on the provider’s site.

Is the discount guaranteed?+

No. Offers depend on your country, account, product and promotion. Always check the final price, currency and eligibility before paying.

Do I pay on this website?+

No. This is an independent referral hub. Payments, delivery and support are handled by TikTok or LootBar. We do not collect your game password or payment details.
